d: SOOR, a subsidiary of Master Works, helps organizations stay ahead of evolving cyber threats through advanced cybersecurity and secure infrastructure solutions. SOOR delivers resilient, scalable, and regulation-aligned security across governance, cloud, networks, and managed defense.

SOOR is looking for an IT & Strategy Planning Specialist to bridge technology with business goals by developing and tracking IT strategy roadmaps, prioritizing digital investments, and ensuring technology initiatives deliver measurable business value.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
3–5+ years of experience in IT Strategy, Strategic Planning, PMO, Enterprise Architecture, or Technology Consulting.
Strong understanding of IT portfolio management, budgeting, project prioritization, and ROI/business case development.
Proven experience with strategic frameworks, KPI tracking, executive dashboards, and PMO standards.
Solid familiarity with digital transformation methodologies, IT governance, risk management, and cybersecurity regulations.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, TOGAF, COBIT, ITIL) are highly desirable.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
r: Develop, maintain, and communicate the IT strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and security standards.
Lead annual and quarterly IT planning, including budgeting, resource allocation, and investment prioritization.
Assess business needs and emerging technologies, building business cases with clear cost structures, risk assessments, and expected benefits.
Oversee the IT project portfolio, tracking progress, project dependencies, and benefits realization through a PMO framework.
Define and monitor strategic KPIs, performance dashboards, and executive reporting for senior management.
Support enterprise architecture, digital transformation, IT governance, and cybersecurity risk management initiatives.
Manage vendor and stakeholder relationships, serving as a primary link between business units and IT technical teams.
Promote compliance with internal IT policies, security standards, and relevant regulatory frameworks.

q: We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to design and build high-performance, scalable, and secure cloud-native applications. The resource will lead development on several key projects, work in a multi-developer Agile (DevSecOps) environment, and upgrade existing .NET and SharePoint applications to the latest cloud technologies.
Backend: .NET Core, ASP.NET, C#, Entity Framework, Microsoft Visual Studio, Unit Testing Frameworks
Frontend: HTML, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript Libraries, jQuery, AJAX, DHTML, React JS / Angular (Minimum 2 Projects or 2 Years Experience)
Database: Proficient MS SQL Server Programming (T-SQL), Design and Optimize SQL Server Stored Procedures
Cloud & Integration: Azure Cloud Technology, Serverless Functions, Logic Apps, Microservices, REST, JSON, SOA
Authentication: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML, Azure AD
Web & Server: Administer IIS 7 and above in Production Environment, Web Browser Compatibility, Mobile Technologies
Architecture: n-tier Architectures (UI, Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer), Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA)
Legacy: .NET and SharePoint Websites and Applications
Experience: 5 Years in .NET and 2 Years in .NET Core using Azure Cloud Technology plus some legacy development knowledge.
Strong experience in software development using .NET Core, SharePoint, ASP.NET, C#, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Entity Framework.
Ability to work in Agile / DevSecOps / DevOps environment.
Strong troubleshooting, code quality, and documentation skills.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.
r: Design and build high-performance, scalable, and secure cloud-native applications.
Design microservices, APIs, and Web Apps.
Implement Serverless Functions and Logic Apps for event-driven processes and integrations.
Lead development on several key projects.
Work in a multi-developer Agile environment (DevSecOps).
Meet with Solution Architect and Analysts to determine application and website requirements.
Develop identified solutions while respecting functional and organic specifications in compliance with established standards.
Upgrade and revamp existing .NET and SharePoint websites and applications to the latest cloud technology.
Deploy functional websites, programs, and applications using automated process (DevOps and Azure DevOps Cloud Services).
Draft software and application operating procedures.
Work with QA team to ensure quality of product code is up to established standards.
Set up, execute, maintain, and improve quality in procedures and processes for functional application management, including monitoring of correct execution of Master Data Management changes.
Participate in structured walk-throughs and other activities to review systems and provide training and support.
